name: email
label: Email
help: Provide at least one of Email or Phone. Used to find an existing contact.

name: phone
label: Phone
help: Provide at least one of Email or Phone. Any Brazilian format is accepted, for example `(11) 99999-0000`; Perpetuus stores it as `+5511999990000`.

name: name
label: Name
help: Required when a new contact is created.

name: matchBy
label: Match by
help: Fields used to find an existing contact, in this order. Leave empty to match by email and then by phone.

name: cpf
label: CPF
help: Brazilian individual taxpayer ID. Perpetuus rejects invalid numbers.

name: cnpj
label: CNPJ
help: Brazilian company taxpayer ID. Perpetuus rejects invalid numbers.

name: customFields
label: Custom fields
help: Contact custom fields as key and value pairs, for example key `origem` and value `Website`.
